items.sentence: Today, the picky cat will reject any food without fresh fish.
Today, sailors gaze at the wide ocean from the tall deck.
The brown bear will cherish the drawing from its little friend.
The village displayed great hospitality to the weary traveling musicians.
Today, the archaeologists will uncover an old pot beneath the sand.
Friends use casual language while chatting after the formal meeting.
Today, their mutual love of drawing made them fast friends.
Today, the crew waved a cheerful farewell from the sailing ship.
Today, I owe my neighbor two coins for the fresh eggs.
Classmates treat the new student with patience and respect.
